name: Cognitive Maze v2.5.0 - Tactical Radar Mini-Map & Dynamic Quest Redesign
notes: Version 2.5.0 — Major Feature Release: Introduces the zero-allocation Tactical Radar Mini-Map HUD across Hub World and Quarters 1-4 with aspect-ratio preservation, camera viewport wireframe, player beacon, and question station status tracking (toggleable with [M] or fist gesture); completely redesigned kid-friendly Assessment Selection modal with vector iconography and responsive controls; enhanced student confirmation modal with celebratory fanfare; dynamic assessment progress denominator calculation (100% mastery across 3 terms); blocks remedial corridor while keeping game progression seamless; hardened cloud roster synchronization and offline caching.
